newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver closes sharply higher, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver closes sharply higher, gold steady.

text.p: Silver prices closed steeply higher on Tuesday on a firm overnight world trend and limited arrivals, dealers said.
"Fresh buying by industrial users pushed the prices further up," said leading dealer Mahavir Shah. Silver was down 10 rupees per kg on Monday.
"Speculators also remained active buyers following a rally in the world market," Shah said. The cost of imported silver is higher than local prices at present," he said.
Gold prices too opened firm but remained steady on limited activity, dealers said.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) settled 200 rupees higher at 57,600 rupees. Biscuits were down 300 rupees on Monday.
